summary: The repaired Playwright TypeScript tests compile and run correctly, use Playwright APIs properly with awaited asynchronous assertions, and maintain all test case IDs. Selectors are reasonable given the context, and the tests are maintainable and reusable. Minor improvements could be made in selector specificity and test data handling.

issues.description: Selectors such as '.product-item' and role-based selectors assume certain DOM structure and roles which may not be robust if the UI changes.
issues.recommendation: Consider using more specific or data-test attribute selectors to improve selector robustness.

issues.description: Category name and URL fragment are hardcoded constants which may require updates if the app changes.
issues.recommendation: Consider externalizing test data or deriving it dynamically to improve maintainability.

recommendations: Use data-test or similar attributes for selectors to improve robustness.
Externalize test data to configuration files or environment variables.
Add comments to clarify assumptions about the UI structure.
